app.title: MARA review workbench
budget.note: MARA sets no call quota: these are actual counts and the bars compare the roles; tokens cover the context and reviewer calls only.
card.findings_sub: accepted by the jury; {rejected} rejected, {dropped} dropped of {total}
card.gaps_sub: incomplete reasons; what is unverified stays visible
card.queue_sub: human-queue items; the jury could not decide {n}
card.tools_sub: at error or warning level; {ran}/{total} tools ran, {n} results
col.title: Title
demo.body: It shows three mock model families reviewing the repository's deliberately vulnerable sample (captured {when}). It talks to no server and cannot start a review or change a setting; to use the workbench, run mara on your own machine.
demo.title: Read-only demo: a snapshot of one offline mock review
dim.note: Dimension score = 100 minus the penalties of accepted findings by severity and evidence tier; any dimension below the floor blocks the gate. An incomplete review has no overall score.
drawer.skeptic_abstained: The skeptic abstained (a refusal or an invalid reply); this finding went unchallenged.
drawer.votes_note: * the judge's family co-produced the finding (used only when there are too few independent judges; the vote is discounted).
env.cfg.label: MODEL ENDPOINTS
env.cfg.note: Each config is validated as mara check-config validates it; a config that fails its policies cannot run a review.
env.cfg.title: Model endpoints and configs
env.confirm_install: Tools will be downloaded as tools/versions.lock pins them, checked against their SHA-256 and the publishers' signatures (needs gh and gpg). Continue?
env.confirm_trivy: The trivy offline vulnerability database (hundreds of MB) will be downloaded and its digests recorded. Continue?
env.heading: Tools & execution environment
env.job.label: MAINTENANCE JOB
env.job.title: Maintenance job
env.lock_changed: tools/versions.lock changed since the tools were installed; reinstall them.
env.platform: The tools are locked for {locked} and this host is {os}: the binary tools cannot be installed and reviews stay incomplete (see INSTALL.md on WSL 2).
env.sub: L0 tools run only from the locked, verified tool directory, never from PATH; model credentials show only whether they are set.
env.tools.label: L0 DETERMINISTIC TOOLS
env.tools.note: The installer checks every SHA-256 and runs the publisher's verification; any mismatch aborts. Reviews look only in this directory, never on PATH.
env.tools.title: Deterministic tools
env.trivy.label: TRIVY OFFLINE DB
env.trivy.title: trivy offline database
env.ws.label: WORKSPACE
env.ws.title: Workspace

error.bad_host: The Host header does not name this loopback server.

error.bad_path: Not a usable path (a NUL character, for example).

error.config_invalid: The config cannot be loaded (structure or policies).

error.cross_origin: Requests from other sites are refused.
error.demo_read_only: This is a read-only demo and cannot do that; run mara on your own machine

error.internal_error: Internal error in the local service.
error.job_unavailable: This workspace has no such maintenance script.

error.network: Cannot reach the local service (is mara still running?)
error.no_report: This review has no readable report.
error.path_outside_workspace: Evidence input directories must lie inside the workspace.
error.provider_mismatch: The mode does not match the config's model providers.
error.sarif_dir_not_dir: The SARIF directory does not exist.
error.target_not_dir: The target is not an existing directory.
error.target_required: Enter the source directory to review.
error.unauthenticated: The session is not valid; open the URL printed by mara.
error.unknown_tool: The tool is not in tools/versions.lock.
families.label: {n} model families
gap.excluded: {n} files excluded by rule (secret files, symlinks, outside the increment…); see the report's coverage.
gap.none: Nothing unverified: the review is complete.
home.c01.body: semgrep, gitleaks, osv-scanner, trivy, zizmor and csp-evaluator run as pinned, verified binaries with neutral settings.
home.c01.title: L0 deterministic anchors
home.c02.body: Reviewers never see each other's output; the skeptic comes from another family; the jury votes blinded, in forward and reverse order.
home.c02.title: Independent review panel
home.c03.body: Every quote must exist in the file; evidence tiers A–D, CVSS 4.0 and the gate are computed by code, never self-reported by a model.
home.c03.title: Evidence tiers and the gate
home.feature.body: Deterministic tools run first; several model families then review eleven dimensions independently. A skeptic tries to refute, a red team judges exploitability, a blinded jury votes, and code computes the evidence tier and the gate.
home.feature.l2: The common ground is the evidence.
home.first_use: First time? In New review, choose Offline demo: the built-in deliberately vulnerable sample and three offline mock model families run the whole pipeline with no network, no keys and no code sent anywhere.
home.no_runs: No reviews yet. Choose New review, or run the offline demo end to end.
home.runs.label: REVIEW HISTORY
home.sub: Read the code, ground the evidence, then decide; every conclusion links back to a file and a line.
home.title: Security you can trace.
hreason.decision_not_usable: the human decision is not usable
hreason.majority_needs_human: the judge majority says a human must decide
hreason.position_inconsistent: the forward and reverse passes disagree
hreason.skeptic_refuted_jury_overrode: refuted by the skeptic, overridden by the jury
hreason.tier_c_high: tier C at High or above
logout.how: To come back, open the URL printed in the terminal by
logout.sub: It has not received, or has forgotten, the token of the running mara; the server and any running review go on.
logout.title: This browser has no key to this server
member.reassigned_d: Not configured for this role, but assigned because of a finding's finder families (the skeptic and the red team must come from another family).
nav.label: Main menu
new.base_hint: Review only the files changed since this ref and their import neighbours; scores are not comparable with a full review.
new.busy: A review is already running. One review runs at a time: wait for it or cancel it first.
new.calib: The target is a calibration sample under calib/samples/ (--calibration-sample)
new.config_hint: Configs under config/ and config/examples/; policies P1–P8 are checked when it loads.
new.config_refused_d: This config fails its policy checks and mara review refuses to load it; fix the config first.
new.fail_gate: Exit with code 2 when the gate blocks (--fail-on-gate)
new.fixtures_hint: Offline demo only: replay another set of mock responses (inside the workspace).
new.heading: New white-box review
new.live_d: Calls the configured models; source code goes only to the endpoints the policies allow.
new.live_missing: Missing credential variables: {names}. Set them in the terminal that starts mara, then restart it.
new.live_notice: Live review: source code is sent to the model endpoints below
new.live_notice_d: Only to models declared on-prem, zero-retention, or retained with a recorded approval (policy P5), and only after the gitleaks secret preflight passes.
new.mock_d: Three mock families replay recorded answers; no network, no keys.
new.mock_notice: Offline demo: no network, no code sent
new.mock_notice_d: The result is a designed demonstration: one mock family fabricates a quote, one refuses a dimension, one flips a vote between passes, to exercise every defence. Expect an incomplete review and a blocked gate.
